payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset, including their performance and characteristics.

claims.text: Extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset include TextRank, LexRank, SumBasic, C_SKIP, and SemSentSum.
C_SKIP and SemSentSum achieved the best results among the extractive models on the GameWikiSum dataset.
TextRank and LexRank performed worse than other models on the GameWikiSum dataset.
